name: Sefon Holdings Limited
summary: Sefon Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, sells apparel products with designing and sourcing services to fashion retailers and wholesalers in Europe, North America, Asia, and South America. It operates in two segments, Supply of Apparel Products; and Institutional Catering. The company offers institutional catering services to private institutions. It also provides consultation and corporate management services, as well as source and quality assurance services; operates a showroom; and invests in properties.
